_meta.purpose: Code groupings the rules need: evaluation-and-management severity ladders, preventive services that carry a statutory $0 cost share, and codes that signal an emergency encounter.
_meta.note: Descriptions are paraphrased. The CPT code set itself is maintained and licensed by the American Medical Association; see docs/reference-data.md before shipping the full set commercially.

em_ladders.top_level_note: 99285 is reserved for high-severity presentations posing an immediate significant threat to life or physiologic function.
99215 requires high-complexity decision-making or roughly 40 minutes of total time on the date of the encounter.
99205 requires high-complexity decision-making or roughly 60 minutes of total time on the date of the encounter.

preventive_services.99382: Preventive visit, new patient, early childhood
preventive_services.99383: Preventive visit, new patient, late childhood
preventive_services.99392: Preventive visit, established patient, early childhood
preventive_services.99393: Preventive visit, established patient, late childhood
preventive_services.G0121: Screening colonoscopy, not meeting high-risk criteria

ancillary_specialties._note: Specialties a patient cannot realistically choose when they are already at the facility. Under the No Surprises Act these can never balance bill at an in-network facility, even with a signed waiver.
